Hero_Desc_LeviGraduate:
After a long apprenticeship, Levi has advanced to become a full-fledged witch.
Her thesis drawing on countless part-time jobs became a sensation in the Witch Kingdom.
Though fully qualified, she remains the youngest member, and her workload seems unchanged from her part-time days.
Album_Hobby_LeviGraduate: Visiting places where she worked as an apprentice
Album_Wish_LeviGraduate: To make the Witch Kingdom a good place to work
Album_LeviGraduate1: After drifting through countless part-time jobs as an apprentice witch, Levi has finally become a full-fledged witch. Judging by the workload, however, little seems to have changed.
Album_LeviGraduate2: Life as a full-fledged witch is far removed from the pension-funded leisure she imagined, but she finds it rewarding in its own way.
Album_LeviGraduate3: For a while after becoming a full-fledged witch, Levi struggled financially even more than she had as an apprentice. Resisting the urge to take side jobs was difficult. She may secretly be a workaholic.
Album_LeviGraduate4: Levi no longer takes Posher's weakening potion. She says she cannot keep up with a full-fledged witch's duties while weakened. Witch society is certainly unforgiving.
Album_LeviGraduate5: Levi often clings to Barie and begs for help. Even as a full-fledged witch, she still struggles with formatting reports and papers.
Album_LeviGraduate6: Fricle has been working Levi relentlessly since her promotion. Levi believes she was abducted into laboratory slavery, but perhaps this shows how highly Fricle values her.
Album_LeviGraduate7: Whenever she has time, Levi visits her former workplaces and occasionally teaches their part-timers her techniques. Stories like these show how much she has grown.
LoveHero_LeviGraduate: You came looking for me. Becoming a full-fledged witch was worth it.
LoveHeroCancel_LeviGraduate: Next time, please visit the laboratory. I will probably still be there...
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Hate1: She sometimes sees witches enjoying this, but says she cannot understand it no matter how often she looks.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Hate2: She does not dislike the flavor, but its aroma still brings back unpleasant memories.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like1: She ate happily, saying nothing could beat its value. Sadly, witch duties leave her no time to visit the theater these days.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like10: She said this alone could help her withstand any number of work bombs from Fricle.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like2: She has loved this since her part-time days, and it has now become Levi's soul food.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like3: Levi likes how eating this for breakfast keeps her full all day.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like4: She savored it, saying even full-fledged witches rarely get to eat such fine food.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like5: She says it restores her energy when tired. Becoming a full-fledged witch has not made her any less exhausted.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like6: She says it is perfect during witch duties and secretly eats one whenever the senior witches are not looking.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like7: She loved how its bittersweet flavor resembled her own struggle to earn a full witch's appointment.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like8: She pocketed it for an all-nighter and became delighted when I gave her several more.
Food_ChefNote_LeviGraduate_Like9: Even while eating, she sorted them by color, a habit from her packaging jobs.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_LeviGraduate: Now I too am a proud member of witch society.
Gacha_Result_Line1_LeviGraduate: Allow me to introduce myself properly. I look forward to working with you!
Gacha_Result_Line2_LeviGraduate: Wants to leave work on time
LeviGraduate_Growth: My name is Levi, a fully qualified witch.
LeviGraduate_Growth1: There is no end to learning.
LeviGraduate_Growth2: Surely everyone will see me in a new light now?
LeviGraduate_Victory1: This will be reflected in my performance review, right?
LeviGraduate_Victory2: I can go straight home without returning to work? Hooray!
LeviGraduate_Defeat1: Do I... have to write an incident report?
LeviGraduate_Defeat2: Could you cover for me, Master?
LeviGraduate_Affinity1_1: Even after becoming a fully qualified witch, my income has hardly changed...
LeviGraduate_Affinity1_2: If I keep working hard, someday my efforts will surely see the light of day.
LeviGraduate_Affinity2: I still have to study on my days off, but that is better than having no days off at all.
LeviGraduate_Affinity1_3: I thought an office job would be easier than part-time work!
LeviGraduate_Affinity3: Will I be able to teach someone else someday too?
LeviGraduate_Affinity4: Barie is a good friend. At last, I can stand beside her as an equal.
LeviGraduate_Affinity5: I sometimes visit UFC as a customer... but the wait is difficult. If I made the food, it would come out immediately.
LeviGraduate_Affinity6: My life is still not comfortable, but I feel much more at ease inside.
LeviGraduate_Affinity7: Whenever the Order needs help, please call me. Ah! I do not mean as mere manual labor.
LeviGraduate_Die1: Ugh! It looks like I still have a long way to go.
LeviGraduate_LevelUp: I will show you proactive growth.
LeviGraduate_Equipment: This should improve my work efficiency.
LeviGraduate_HeroSkill: I should add this to my resume too!
LeviGraduate_HeroUpgrade: I want to reach even greater heights.
LeviGraduate_Board: Is this where my business trip is this time?
LeviGraduate_DeckSetting1: Fulfill your role, no matter the position.
LeviGraduate_DeckSetting2: This is my chance to earn everyone's recognition!
LeviGraduate_Stage: I will prove myself through results!
LeviGraduate_Touch1: Ow! Why are you doing this?
LeviGraduate_Touch1_1: This is a test of patience, right?
LeviGraduate_Touch2_1: It feels like my fatigue is melting away.
LeviGraduate_Touch1_2: As a full-fledged witch, I should be able to endure this much.
LeviGraduate_Touch2_2: I will take that to mean I should work even harder.
LeviGraduate_DutchRubEnd2: I am going to forget everything I studied!
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_LeviGraduate_Skin1: Levi (Graduate) after work. Occasionally, she is called back out in this outfit even after business hours.
LeviGraduate_Growth1_Skin1: Now I think I can rest even more efficiently.
LeviGraduate_Growth2_Skin1: Resting properly is part of the job too.
LeviGraduate_LevelUp_Skin1: I feel like I will be able to leave work even earlier tomorrow.
LeviGraduate_Equipment_Skin1: Comfortable clothes are best when resting.
LeviGraduate_HeroSkill_Skin1: Even resting has its own techniques and skills~
LeviGraduate_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: You should rest well after reaching your goal.
LeviGraduate_Touch1_Skin1: You are doing this even on my day off?
LeviGraduate_Touch1_1_Skin1: Something like this cannot disturb my rest anymore~
LeviGraduate_Touch1_2_Skin1: When I think of it as a massage, I feel myself relaxing...
LeviGraduate_Touch2_2_Skin1: You worked hard today too, Master...
LeviGraduate_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: I finished every last task I was assigned before resting!
Aside_Get_LeviGraduate1: It took me far too long. I hope it will not be the same for you.
LeviGraduate_AsideGet: It took me far too long. I hope it will not be the same for you.
LeviGraduate_Hit5: I am going to get angry!
LeviGraduate_PowerAttack1: There will be plenty to learn, right?
LeviGraduate_No2: I do not think that is right.
LeviGraduate_Birthday: Happy birthday! Since it is your birthday, Master, will it be declared a public holiday?
LeviGraduate_Gacha2: Allow me to introduce myself properly. I look forward to working with you.
LeviGraduate_Gacha3: I am now a proud, full-fledged member of witch society too.
LeviGraduate_Greeting: I look forward to working with you.
LeviGraduate_Line1: Hard work is always rewarded. Someday.
LeviGraduate_Line2: I have to finish this before it is time to leave!
LeviGraduate_Line3: Is there any job out there that at least pays overtime?
LeviGraduate_Lobby: Should I forget about work for a while? Sometimes you need to just space out.
LoveLetter_LeviGraduate:
Hello, Master!
People say graduation is not an ending but a new beginning, and now I understand why. I only recently began working as a full-fledged witch, so everything remains confusing. Still, I am glad your cooking in the banquet hall has not changed. Hehe. Let us visit UFC for fried carrots again! This time, I will buy you two servings!
LoveCall_LeviGraduate:
Have you been well, Master? This is Levi.

It is still working hours, but I am on break, so I called. You must be working too, but since you answered immediately, perhaps you are also resting.

Truthfully, I want to talk longer and visit in person if possible. I thought becoming a full-fledged witch would give me more free time, but it did not.

If I rise higher in the Witch Kingdom, perhaps I will have more chances to see you. Wanting to see you gives me another reason to work harder. I am always grateful to you.

It feels wonderful to have effort rewarded and ability recognized. I will keep working so I can help the Witch Kingdom and the Order even more.

My break is over. I will call again, Master.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP01_001: I want to give Fricle a present. What would be good?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP01_003: As expected, Master knows what is good! No witch dislikes fried carrots!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP01_005: Ugh, what witch would like that?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP01_007: I dislike that. It brings back bad memories...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_001: Do you think Boss Posher has found her next part-time worker?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_002: Of course. Posher must have found someone long ago.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_003: A-as expected. I was only a cost-effective part-time worker, after all...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_004: No, it would be difficult to find a part-time worker like you in the Witch Kingdom.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_005: O-oh~ Why would you say something like that? You are embarrassing me. Hehe...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_006: Why not return for a short-term job when you have time?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP02_007: I-I made such a grand farewell. Going back after that would be a little...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP03_001: Does the longer hair I grew this time suit me?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP03_003: Really? I am glad I grew it out!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP03_005: B-but I was only an apprentice witch then... Do you like my old self better?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP03_006: Oh, did you change your hair?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP03_007: Hey! I went to the trouble of growing it out, and you did not even notice?!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_001: Becoming a full-fledged witch has made me strangely nervous. Will I do well?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_002: You will. You handled all those part-time jobs, did you not?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_003: Hehe, that is true! Hearing Master say that gives me courage!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_004: I hear the work of a full-fledged witch is far harder than any part-time job...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_005: Eek?! Is it really that bad...?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_006: Who is good at everything from the beginning? You have to grow step by step.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP04_007: That is true. I will keep growing and someday rise even higher than Fricle...!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP05_001: After I eat this, I am going to Monatium. I want to brag to that potion thief!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP05_002: Hmm... Would it not be better to avoid that?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP05_004: Sounds good. She will be surprised when she sees you.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP05_005: Right? I am already looking forward to it.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP05_006: Someone who found employment bragging to someone unemployed... As expected of a witch.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP05_007: Ah! N-now that I think about it, you are right. Hmm, what should I do...?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_001: After staying up every night, I cannot sleep when I go to bed on time. Is there a way to sleep well?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_002: How about giving up the energy tonics first?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_003: What? How did you know I keep drinking energy tonics?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_004: If you find such a method, tell me too...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_005: So Master cannot sleep properly either...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_006: How about buying a new blanket?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP06_007: A blanket? I do not have money for something like... Huh, do I have money now?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_001: Would you like a copy of my thesis too, Master?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_002: Sure. Shall I give it a read?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_003: I knew you would say that, so I brought a copy. Here!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_004: No, thank you. Even if I receive a witch's thesis, I cannot understand it very well.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_005: True, the content is a little difficult for Master to understand... Hehe.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_006: Thank you. I happened to need a trivet.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP07_007: I-I will not give it to you if you intend to use my precious thesis for that!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP08_001: Now that I am a full-fledged witch, am I no longer allowed to eat for free?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP08_004: You are a full-fledged witch now. You have to pay.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP08_005: A-as expected. I am a full-fledged witch now, after all...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP08_006: Well, it should be fine occasionally, should it not?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP08_007: Then... if I come only occasionally, every visit comes with free food, right?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_001: Nothing changed even after I became a full-fledged witch... Is there truly no way to live comfortably?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_002: There is no paradise waiting wherever you flee...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_003: Do not lose hope, Master. There must be a way somewhere...!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_004: Let us not give up. We can search together.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_005: Let us find it together. A way to earn money while barely working!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_006: There is no such way. We have no choice but to work hard every day.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP09_007: That cannot be. I worked so hard precisely because I did not want to work hard...!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_001: After quitting all my part-time jobs, I have time left over. Is there anything I can help with, Master?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_002: Perfect timing. Could you help move those boxes?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_003: Those boxes? Hehe, this will take no time at all!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_004: You are a guest. Sit and make yourself comfortable.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_005: Is that so? S-sitting still the entire time makes me feel a little restless...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_006: Enjoy this while it lasts. You will soon be too busy to catch your breath.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP10_007: Ugh, then I will not move.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_001: What do you do when you have to wake up early?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_002: I set several alarms before going to sleep.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_003: That method really is best, is it not? Master does the same as me.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_004: It helps to promise someone that you will wake each other.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_005: I am meeting Barie that day, so I can ask her.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_006: If you do not sleep, you will still be awake at that time.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP11_007: That is too extreme! Please value your sleep.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_001: What is the most important thing to consider when choosing a workplace?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_002: What work you do matters, but who you work with matters too.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_003: You mean I should find good people. I will remember that.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_004: You should find work that lets you do what you like while developing yourself.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_005: Work I enjoy... Yes, I will search carefully.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_006: The distance between your home and workplace. That is everything.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP12_007: What? Why is that important? I cannot understand it at all.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_001: What do you think is the difference between the youngest full-fledged witch and an apprentice witch?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_002: Hmm... Whether she is allowed to go home, perhaps?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_003: What?! What do you mean? Then where do I sleep...? I can go home, right?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_004: Are they not simply different names?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_005: No! A full-fledged witch and an apprentice witch are completely different!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_006: The difference is whether you can be trusted, perhaps?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP13_007: Hehe, does giving me work mean you trust me too?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_001: ...It still does not feel real that I have become a full-fledged witch.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_002: Perhaps all of this is actually a dream...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_003: No... It cannot be a dream... This is not a dream!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_004: Try going around and bragging to everyone. Would being congratulated make it feel more real?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_005: Good. Then start by congratulating me, Master.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_006: Your heart is still that of an apprentice witch.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP14_007: No~ My mindset is that of a full-fledged witch too!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP15_001: ...I will be able to do well, right?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP15_002: Could worrying too much make even possible things fail?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP15_003: That is true... I think I can afford to be a little more optimistic.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP15_004: Of course. You have worked so hard until now.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP15_005: Hehe, hearing Master say that gives me strength.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP15_007: No, I was not asking for a fortune... But what did you roll?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_001: Will I someday be able to become a teacher and accept an apprentice?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_002: Hmm, would that not be difficult for the current Levi?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_003: Later, I mean, later! Someday I will become a witch with an apprentice of my own.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_004: If you want to become a teacher, should you not start preparing something now?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_005: ...Should I prepare fried sweet potatoes to give as snacks?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_006: Perhaps, once Levi becomes a splendid witch.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP16_007: Hehe, simply imagining it already makes me look forward to it.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP17_001: Sherum said she would give me a book. What kind of book will it be?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP17_002: Surely it will be 'A Guide to Writing a Thesis,' will it not?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP17_003: Is she giving it to me to use when I write theses in the future?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP17_004: Perhaps it will be something like 'The Great Encyclopedia of Witches.'
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP17_005: Hehe, is she giving it to me as a reference now that I am a full-fledged witch?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP17_007: Come on~ My handwriting may be poor, but... that is a book I need...
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_001: Everyone hires only experienced witches, so where are new witches supposed to gain experience?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_002: Do not all those part-time jobs you held count as experience too?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_003: Do they...? It must be better than writing that I did nothing, right?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_004: Gain experience somewhere that lets you gain experience.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_005: Ugh... This conversation feels as though it is going in circles.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_006: Consult someone who knows how diligent you are. I am sure they will show you a way.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP18_007: Ah! I had not thought of that.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP19_001: When will I finally stop being the youngest?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP19_003: It has to! It must come...!
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP19_004: When a new youngest witch arrives.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP19_005: Ugh... That is such an obvious answer, but somehow it feels frustrating.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP19_006: If you become a witch worth following, that dream may come true too.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP19_007: Hehe, I will work hard to become a splendid witch.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP20_001: What should I do if no one leaves work when it is time to go home?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP20_002: Do not worry about how others see you. If you want to leave, then leave.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP20_004: How about helping each other and leaving together?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP20_005: I had not thought of that.
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP20_006: Perhaps they want to leave too, but remain because no one else is going?
Affinity_LeviGraduate_EP20_007: Could that be it? Then should I be the first one to stand up? Hmm...
